RESTRICTIVEDECLARATIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS DECLARATION, made this 13th day of May, 2009, by MI JA HAN and SUNG WOO HAN (the “Hans"), individuals having their principal residence at 185 SPRING STREET, STATEN ISLAND,NEWYORK10304; with SILVER BELL INVESTMENT CO., INC., ("Silver Bell'") a New Jersey Corporation with authority to transact business in the State of New York, having its principal office at 202 CHESTNUT STREEET,ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS,NEWJERSEY 07632; WHEREAS, the Hans are fee simple owners of certain land and improvements thereon commonly known as and located at 165-19 Northern Blvd., Flushing, New York in the City and State of New York, Borough of Queens, designated as Block 5340 Lot 51 (*"Parcel A") on the set forth in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof; WHEREAS,Silver Ball is a fee simple owner of certain land and improvements thereon commonly known as and located at 165-01 through 07 Northern Blvd., Flushing, New York in the City and State of New York, Borough of Queens, designated as Block 5340 Lot 8 ("Parcel B") on the Tax Map of the City of New York, more particularly described by metes and bounds description set forth in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof; WHEREAS, the Hans and Silver Bell (collectively, the “Declarants") desire to impose upon both Parcel A and Parcel B certain restrictions on development rights of the Declarants as further described herein; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants hereinafter contained and other good and valuable consideration the receipt and legal sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged,parties agree and declare asfollows: 1. Parcel A shall not be developed with any further increase in floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York under the current zoning district in effect as of the date of this Declaration; 2. Parcel A shall not be increased horizontally, thus allowing it to exceed the property limits of Parcel A as described herein, regardless of the current or any future amendments to the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork; 3. Parcel A, should it ever be permitted to increase in floor area as defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York then in effect, such increase in floor area shall be limited to the developable rights afforded to Parcel A standing alone without reference to, reliance on, or utilization of Parcel B or any developable rights belonging to Parcel B; and 1
